name: Sergio Malheiros
bio: Sérgio Santiago Victoriano Santos Malheiros (Rio de Janeiro, March 17, 1993) is a Brazilian actor and director. He debuted in 1999 on the program Samba, Pagode e Cia on Rede Globo.  In 2022, he began his career as a director with the short film "Única Saída"
